turns.question: What's the on-time delivery KPI, and how are service credits worked out if Calder misses it?
turns.text:
The on-time delivery KPI is 98% per calendar month, as stated in the Logistics Services Agreement [3].

If Calder misses the KPI, the Customer is entitled to service credits calculated at 5% of the monthly fee for each full percentage point below the KPI, with a maximum cap of 25% of the monthly fee. The monthly fee is GBP 140,000, meaning the maximum service credit per month is GBP 35,000 [2].

For April 2026, the shortfall was 6.5 percentage points, resulting in a service credit of GBP 42,000 (6 × 5% × GBP 140,000). For May 2026, the shortfall was 5 percentage points, resulting in GBP 35,000. For June 2026, the shortfall was 3 percentage points, resulting in GBP 21,000. The total service credits for the three months are GBP 98,000 [1].

The Customer claims GBP 112,000 in service credits, based on 8 full percentage points below the KPI across the three months, even though the actual total shortfall was 14.5 percentage points [1].
